err_attempt_timeout: Say mankirlap ya kagawaan et anggapoy inyaligwas to ed loob na {seconds} segundo, kanian tinmunda iyan sagpot.
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Say pinilim ya authentication file et anggapo, anggapoy karga to odino ag nayarin isulat. Manpili na balidon file, odino i-clear itan ed Settings, insan i-flash lamet.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Walay aka-cache ya firmware file ya anggapo. Pilien so Select Software pian na-rebuild iray na-extract ya file odino na-download lamet so firmware archive. Saya so problema ed lokal a file, aliwan isyu ed koneksion na USB.
err_checksum_stall_no_sp_desc: Say beripikasyon et tinmunda legan ya manpapaspas. Ipangasin ikonekta lamet so player mo tan salien lamet.
err_checksum_stall_sp_failover: Say verification et tinmunda legan ya manpapaspas na {failed}. Irerekomenda mi ya salien mo lamet so {next} ed {model} mo.
err_code_missing_images: Saray litrato na firmware ya anggapo ed pakete
err_code_partition_table_invalid: Ag-asumpal so panag-verify na partition table kayari na impansulat
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Say USB COM port et ag nalukasan (error 1013). No i-restart so computer mo, nabulos so aka-lock ya port. I-restart so computer mo tan salien lamet.
err_connect_failover_recovery:
{failed} et ag akakonekta ed {model} mo.

Salien natan na Updater so {next} imbes.

I-disconnect so USB tan mangusar na paperclip / pin pian pindoten so buton ed baetan na headphone jack tan USB Port, insan pindoten so next.
err_connection_failed_desc: Agmakapangiletneg na malet a koneksion ed manag-awit. Seguroen ya aka-off so device (mangusar na pin pian pindoten so reset button no nakaukolan), ekalen so USB, tan ikonekta lamet no nakerew.
err_driver_missing_desc: Nayarin nagawa iyan error no ag-aka-install so MediaTek USB driver. Pindoten so Download Drivers pian ni-install so MediaTek USB driver, i-restart so computer mo, tan salien lamet.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Naabala so pan-flash odino ag-asumpal so pansulat. Nengnengen no say USB cable et akasaksak a maong tan say baterya et walaan na magenap ya karga, insan salien lamet.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Walay ag-iilaloan ya lingo ya agawa legan na pangi-install ({detail}). Sigpot ya erepen so player, ikonekta lamet no walay kerew, insan salien lamet.
err_keep_data_failed: Agmo nayarian ya pansiansiaen iray setting tan media: say firmware folder et ag nayarin isulat. Anggapoy aka-install.
err_missing_package_files_desc: Say firmware package et anggapoy scatter file odino saray nakaukolan ya image file. Ipangasin i-download lamet so pakete odino manpili na kompleton file na firmware.
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Say flashing tool et mangipapanengneng na parehon linya ed apalabas ya {seconds} segundo tan singa agto la itutuloy so pansulat na firmware. Nayarin ag-inmabobon so flash. No saya so unor ed duaran pansagpot ed kada paraan ed sakey a sistema ya nayarin ompawil ed baetan da, odino no say MTKClient labat so wala ed sayan makina, i-restart so computer tan salien lamet.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Sayan computer et nayarin i-install met ya usaren so SP Flash Tool. No sarag mo, onalis kad SP Flash Tool tan salien mo lamet.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: Say MTKClient labat so nayarin usaren ed sayan pangi-install. Nayarin ag-inmabobon so flash. I-restart so computer tan salien lamet.
err_pmt_format_required_desc: Inreport na SP Flash Tool ya anguman so partition table na player (8502). Sayan firmware et nepeg ya i-install ed Format All + Download mode, ya mangi-reformat ed internal storage.
err_sp_brom_da_fail: Say download agent et ag nayarin ipawit ed player. Erepen mo tan ikonekta mo lamet.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Say manag-awit et masakbay ya nan-power up. Erepen ya maong, insan mo ikonekta lamet.
err_sp_com_port: Say kagawaan et agto nalukasan so serial port to. Isara so arum ya mankirlap ya kagawaan tan ikonekta lamet.
err_sp_da_init_sync: Ag makagapo so download agent. Salien so sananey a paraan na panag-flash.
err_sp_da_invalid_type: Impulisay na player so download agent (error 6104). Usaren so Download Agent ya kaiba na SP Flash Tool, tan nengnengen no say firmware et mipara ed sayan player.
err_sp_download_fail: Naabala so pansulat. Nengnengen so USB cable tan port tan say karga na baterya, insan salien lamet.
err_sp_enable_dram: Say kagawaan et agmakapangigapo na memorya na manag-awit. Usaren so pakete ya ginawa parad sayan eksakton modelo.
err_sp_storage_read: Say kagawaan et agto nabasa so storage na manag-awit. Nengnengen so koneksion; nayarin walay depekto na hardware na device.
err_sp_timeout: Say kagawaan et agbalot anengneng so manag-awit. Pansiansiaen ya aka-off tan ag-akasaksak, insan ikonekta so USB cable no walay kerew.
err_sp_wrong_model: Lingon modelo na manag-awit so inkonektam. Pindoten so × button pian nakansela iyan install, insan pilien so software parad player ya inkonekta yo.
err_storage_full_desc: Naupotan lay storage space na computer mo. Mangiter kay disk space ed drive mo tan salien mo lamet.
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Say flashing tool odino saray nakaukolan ya system drivers et ag nayarin i-initialize. Ipangasin nengnengen iray permiso na sistema, setup na driver, odino i-install lamet so aplikasyon.
err_usb_bus_down_recovery: Anggapoy nanengneng na macOS ya USB device natan, kanian ag naabot so {model} mo. I-plug so player tan antokaman ya USB hub o dock, insan i-restart so Mac - say USB controller et kaukolan toy power cycle antis ya onggapo so sananey ya install.
err_usb_disconnected_recovery: Say {model} mo et adiskonekta. I-disconnect so USB tan mangusar na paperclip / pin pian pindoten so buton ed baetan na headphone jack tan USB Port, insan pindoten so next.
flash_btn_open_sp_gui: Lukasan so SP Flash Tool GUI
flash_cancel_msg: Walay proseso na flash ya ondadalagan natan. Labay mon kanselaen itan tan igapo so balon sakey?
flash_close_confirm: Segurado ka kasin labay mon itunda so pangi-install tan isara so {app}?
flash_connect_failed_hint: {model} ag makakonekta? Salien iya: I-disconnect so USB, mangusar na paperclip odino pin pian pindoten so reset button, insan ikonekta lamet so USB cable.

flash_keep_data_unavailable: Sayan pangi-install et mangi-reset ed saray setting tan media ed internal storage na player.

flash_keep_data_warning: No itultuloy mo ya anggapoy saya, saray setting tan media mo et na-reset ed internal storage na player.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox: No itultuloy mo ya anggapoy saya, naekal iray tema, font tan setting na Rockbox mo, tan na-reset so internal storage na player.

flash_method_confirm: Say paraan na pangi-install et anguman ed {method}. Seguroen ya aka-unplug tan aka-off so player, insan i-click so Next.
flash_method_note_auto: Auto: SP Flash Tool ed Windows tan Linux, MTKClient ed macOS. Sarag mon i-switch ya mano-mano ed anggan dinan ya plataporma.
flash_method_note_mtk_mac: Simulated macOS mode: ipapaandar toy Mac flow ed sayan makina, say MTKClient labat so backend tan saray macOS-specific prompts so nipanengneng. Parad panagsukimat labat; say app et onggapo lamet pian maka-apply.

flash_paperclip_explanation: I-disconnect so USB cable tan mangusar na paperclip o pin pian pindoten so reset button, insan salien ya ikonekta lamet.

support_methods_subtitle: Pilien so labay mon paraan na panagkontribusyon. Kada donasyon et direktan manpopondo ed panag-download, panag-host, tan panag-test na hardware.
support_story_1_body: Say Innioasis et naynay ya mangipapaway na balo iran firmware parad saray manag-awit a singa say Y1 (ya manpupuntirya ed saray hidden board revisions a singa say 6.0, 7.0, tan 8.0) ya ag-onsasalitan mamapaandi ed saray daan lan kagawaan. Say mas grabe ni, say website da et anggapoy pasakbay tan anggapoy access ed saray datin mankikimey ya firmware pian makabawi ed inka-bricked state. Say Updater tan say Community Firmware project so mangaala na saray piraso: i-archive mi so kada legacy stock ROM, automatikon i-verify so hardware revision yo, tan pansiansiaen min ligtas so player yo.
support_story_1_headline: No ontuloy iray managgaway produkto, onaligwas so komunidad.
support_story_1_item_1: Panangiliktar ed Saray Aderal ya Manag-awit: Say safety checks et mamaseguro ya saray balon update et agbalot makaderal ed daan iran hardware.
support_story_1_item_2: Archived Stock ROMs: Kompleton koleksion na orihinal iran firmware na pabrika Innioasis ya inekal.
support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Full flashing tools parad macOS, Linux, tan Windows.
support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Automatikon pakadetektaan na board pian lanang mon naala so dugan pakete.
support_story_1_lead: Protektaan so device mo manlapud saray silent hardware traps tan saray aderal ya rebisyon.
support_story_2_body: Say pananap na opisyal ya software na Innioasis et kaslakan ya mankabaliksan na pananap ed saray forum parad saray expired lan Google Drive links, inatey lan Baidu cloud shares, tan misteryoson zip files ya anggapoy flashing tools. Nanggawa kami na napanmatalkan, independentin download network ya walay na-verify ya integridad na SHA-256, update notifications, tan step-by-step guided installs. Saray donasyon yo so direktan mangisimpen ed saray download tan hosting ya manggagawa ed saya ya posible 24 oras ed sanagew, 365 ya agew ed sakey taon.
support_story_2_headline: Anggapoy aderal ya Google Drives. Anggapoy panaghula. Mankikimey labat so firmware.
support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Maples, direktan panag-download ya anggapoy limitasyon ed panag-download odino inatey iran link.
support_story_2_item_2: Update Notifications: Man-alerto no wala ray balon community release o fixes ya onlesa.
support_story_2_item_3: Guided Step-by-Step Installs: Saray malinew ya visual prompts so mangigiya ed sika ed kada panpindot na buton.
support_story_2_item_4: Multilingual Community: Sigpot ya lokal ed Ingles, Intsik, Aleman, Kastila, Pranses tan Hapon.
support_story_2_lead: Maples tan na-verify ya imprastraktura na komunidad ya talagan napanmatalkan mo.
support_story_3_body: Say stock factory software et mangibabalang labat ed no antoy nagawaan na Y1 o Y2 hardware yo. Say komunidad mi so angiter na bilay ed Rockbox, anlemew ya custom operating systems, audiophile codec playback, tan custom themes. Mansasaliw kami na nanduruman klase na hardware manlapud bulsa mi pian nasubok, na-reverse engineer, tan na-verify so kada install. Say panuporta ed Updater so direktan manpopondo ed sarayan test units tan mamapeles na custom firmware development.
support_story_3_headline: Ilukas so interon potensyal na Innioasis player mo.
support_story_3_item_1: One-Click Rockbox: Audiophile playback tan custom themes ya na-install ed loob na pigaran segundo.
support_story_3_item_2: Community Firmware: Saray inyaligwas ed baterya, mas malinis ya UI, tan modernon suporta ed audio codec.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Mansusubok kami ed saray totoon pisikal ya kagawaan antis ya ipalapag so antokaman ya build.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% libre, privacy-first ya software ya anggapoy ads o tracking.
support_story_3_lead: Mangitarok na Rockbox, custom lightweight operating systems, tan kawayangan na audiophile.
support_story_4_body: No say sakey a kompanya na hardware et onalis ed onsublay ya gadget da, saray daan ya modelo et naandi la. Say Innioasis et anggapoy suporta tod Linux, anggapoy transparent ya changelogs, tan anggapoy mainomay ya paraan pian makabawi no ag-onkualipika so sakey ya install. Say Updater et wala lapud saray mahilig ya manguusar et ag nepeg ya ibantak so perpekton maong ya music player. 100% na saray kontribusyon na komunidad so direktan onla ed pamasiansia ed sayan kagawaan ya lukas parad amin.
support_story_4_headline: Tulongan mo kamin manggawa na ag gagawaen na Innioasis.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Napaneknekan ya say recovery et onaagus anggano ag labay ya man-boot iray device.
support_story_4_item_2: Linux First-Class Support: Sigpot ya suportado so MediaTek ya man-flash ed saray Linux distros.
support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Detalyadon release notes pian naamtaan mo no anto ray eksakton pananguman.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Community Funded: Kada kape et mansiansian lukas so archive tan libre parad amin.
support_story_4_lead: Say pangipreserba na firmware ya uusaren na komunidad ya mamapaliis ed saray kagawaan yo ed saray landfill.
